params.justification: All six credit card payment shortfalls are in the 1–3 centavo range and marked as shipping-equivalent. Current tolerance of 1 centavo is too tight; raising to 3 centavos will absorb these small rounding gaps without requiring shipping or fee adjustments.

summary: Raise R7.tolerance_centavos from 1 to 3 to absorb the small rounding gaps (all shortfalls are 1–3 centavos) seen across the credit card payments in this group.
